! skygo plan task.yaml --env SECRET
stderr 'requires KEY=VALUE'
! skygo run task.yaml --env A=x --env A=y
stderr 'duplicate key'
! skygo plan native.yaml --env=
stderr 'apply only to SkyPilot'
! skygo run native.yaml --workdir-ref=
stderr 'apply only to SkyPilot'
! skygo plan task.yaml --workdir-ref unknown.json
stderr 'invalid --workdir-ref'
! stderr 'sensitive-field'

-- task.yaml --
run: echo hi
-- native.yaml --
argv: [echo, hi]
-- unknown.json --
{"sensitive-field":"do-not-print"}
